_about: Contrast set, written 2026-10-09 BEFORE running it: one body area said to be normal or denied next to a complaint somewhere else, pain that spreads (radiation is not a second complaint), two complaints in one breath, and complaints that have stopped. Hindi lines are unpunctuated, as the on-prem recogniser writes them. p = present, n = must not be reported, rf = emergency expected (true) or not (false). Run: npm run test:extraction -- --set contrast
